0022600221.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (7-3, on a one-game win streak) host the Denver Nuggets (5-4, on a one-game losing streak) in Memphis's 11th game of the season, with the Grizzlies 5-0 on the road but 2-3 at home. Memphis sits 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, and 7th in the West, while Denver is 4th in the Northwest, 2 games back, and 10th in the West; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Grizzlies lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 136-119 loss in Denver on April 8, 2026. Memphis is without Quinten Post (head), Richie Saunders (knee, surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back, soreness), while Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee, sprain).
